title: catalog.product.tombstone — Payload Schema
description: Deletion signal emitted by erp.catalog when a product is permanently removed from ERP Core. Consumers must remove this product from every index and storefront listing. Consumers must not interpret the absence of a tombstone as a guarantee that the product still exists — reconciliation via catalog.product.snapshot should be the authoritative source for index completeness.

product_id.description: Identifier of the deleted product. This ID will never be reused by ERP Core after a tombstone is emitted.

product_version.description: Version counter at the time of deletion. Consumers holding a tombstone with an equal or higher product_version for this product_id must discard the incoming message (idempotency). A tombstone always has a higher product_version than any previous catalog.product.changed message for the same product_id.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the deletion was committed in ERP Core.
